_comment_1: TEMPLATE. Copy this file to 'livellm.settings.json' (same folder) and edit that copy.
_comment_2: The copy is git-ignored: no file means the firewall is CLOSED, so a fresh clone and any CI are safe by default.
_comment_3: NEVER put a real key in THIS example file: it is committed. Put it in your git-ignored copy only.
_enabled: THE FIREWALL. true lets these tests call a real LLM and spend tokens. Takes effect on the next run, no IDE or runner restart.
_apiKey: OpenRouter key. Empty falls back to the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable. Beware: the variable is captured when a process STARTS, so a value set while VS or nCrunch is running is not seen, and it can hold an old key while the game uses a newer one from Mod Options.
_model: The model under test: judge the one you actually ship with.
_judgeModel: Model that scores the YES/NO behaviour verdicts. Empty reuses 'model'. A small literal model usually judges better, and costs less.
_reasoningEffort: OpenRouter reasoning effort: low | medium | high, or empty for the provider default. Lowering it also cuts moralizing refusals on adult fiction.
_providerPin: Comma-separated OpenRouter provider slugs, in order. Empty lets OpenRouter route. Some providers moderate their own output and cut a reply mid-sentence.
_allowProviderFallbacks: Whether OpenRouter may fall back to unpinned providers when the pinned ones are unavailable.
_maxTokens: Output cap per chat turn. The game ships 1500.
_presencePenalty: Pushes the model off words it has already used. The game ships 0.3. The one lever that reduces repetition on weaker models.
